name: Egg drop bait

source.file: Need_a_website Clean. Modern. Advanced. DM me to start (web design reel)

best_for: A service or offer you can say in 3 words; direct CTA

timeline.visual: One everyday object creeping toward danger (an egg rolling to the edge of a counter). Plain, quiet, real or simple scene. No text, no person.
Hard cut BEFORE the outcome. Small text, centred, light background: a question to the buyer ('need a website?').
One giant word with a full stop, dark background, light text.
Small text, light background, held ~1.7 s: the CTA ('DM me to start.').
timeline.sound: silence, so the loop back to the bait is seamless

rhythm: cuts every ~0.85 s after the bait; bait ≈ 30 % of the video; CTA held twice as long as a word
why_it_works: Open loop: the brain waits to see the object fall; the video never shows it → rewatches and longer watch time
Pattern interrupt: real-world calm footage, then a hard cut to bold type
Three one-word benefits are readable in under a second each, even muted
Silent tail makes the loop feel continuous; people watch twice before noticing

variables.bait_object: Something from the brand's world creeping to the edge (Buzztorm: the ring light on a desk). Must never fall.
variables.question: The buyer's need as a question, 3–5 words
variables.words: Exactly 3 one-word benefits ending with a full stop
variables.cta: From the brand CTA library, ≤ 5 words

rules: Bait ≤ 2.2 s, no text on it
Words: one per card, same size, alternating primary/paper
Question and CTA at about 40 % of the word size
No voiceover, no music bed; one hit per card
CTA must be from cta.json; claims check applies

build.bait: Engine: one beat with a custom fn that moves the object slowly with ease-out and a growing wobble (see story.js); render frames 0–51 at 24 fps with QA=1. Or a team-supplied real clip (kinetic.json bait.video).
build.cards: kinetic.py with kinetic.json (brand colours and font; side margins for Reels)

variations: Bait objects: a coffee cup sliding, a phone vibrating toward the edge, a domino about to tip, a full glass on a moving table
Swap the 3 words for 3 outcomes or 3 steps
Use a brand character reaching for the object (cut before they catch it)
